status_reason: The geometry is a conservative collision candidate; the actual pre-wired antenna profile and physical retention/rattle/print fit remain unmeasured.
authority: Reviewed machine contract for the bottom-loaded, already-wired RX2 reference-antenna adapter. Values describe the CAD candidate, not production antenna measurements.
derived_assertions: body_axis_z equals body_d/2 plus the 0.20 mm closed-lid floor gap
rail_gap equals body_d plus twice body_radial_clearance
south U-arch diameter equals body_d plus twice body_radial_clearance and therefore clears the complete lower antenna radius
reference mesh bounds and volumes match fresh SCAD selector exports
all access margins in the receipt are recomputed from these facts and the bound enclosure interfaces
excluded_claims: This contract does not convert the supplied flexible-holder voids into an authoritative antenna drawing.
It does not prove physical lock, rattle resistance, cable termination clearance, printer fit, or PRINT_VERIFIED status.
